policy: Additive expansion of the frozen v0.36.0 bank. Original task wording, answers, translations and IDs remain unchanged; sentence block boundaries follow the reviewed grammatical-role map, and all 44 catalog IDs, names and positions stay stable. Source sections map by meaning, not just source ID. Duplicate practice is linked to existing tasks. Completion halves become sentence assembly; exclusive yes-lists supply extra sorting packs. Picture drawings are references only; existing local artwork is used when available.

sentenceBlocks.policy: Subject + verb group + indirect object + object/complement + place + time, where present. Source word order and wording are preserved; questions and imperatives retain their natural grammar.
